usage: Refers to the beat or rhythmic pattern in music; very common in everyday music talk.
Often used with verbs like 跟、夾、捉 to talk about keeping time or playing in sync.
Can describe rhythm in songs, drums, dance, and even speech delivery.
Neutral and high-frequency; safe for learners in both music lessons and casual conversation.
